target_customer: Consumers and workers who receive money from abroad and want a borderless account, wallet and card on stablecoin rails
problem: Receiving money across borders and spending it locally is slow and costly. SpotPay offers one account built on stablecoins for receiving, paying, spending with a card and saving.
business_model: Consumer neobank earning on card interchange, transfers and balances; pricing not found
product_category: Stablecoin based global neobank and wallet

founders.name: Zsika Phillip
prior_employers: Google (Lead Engineer per profile; launch post says tech lead and PM on YouTube Monetization, Ads Monetization and Google Cloud)
founders.background_notes: Per YC page and launch post; grew up between the Caribbean and Latin America.

founders.name: Thomas Cesare-Herriau
prior_employers: Brex (engineer #4, grew to Principal Engineer over six years)
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; led Financial Products and Platforms teams at Brex.

competitors.name: KAST
competitors.what: Stablecoin neobank with card, raised a seed round in December 2024
competitors.funding_then: $10M seed led by HSG and Peak XV, announced 2024-12-12

technical_complexity.rationale: Builds on card issuing and stablecoin infrastructure from third parties, with money transmission compliance as a hard part; founder has fintech engineering experience from Brex.

defensibility.rationale: Stablecoin neobanks were multiplying and use shared infrastructure vendors, so features were copyable in weeks to months.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Plasma launched a stablecoin neobank in June 2026 and Revolut announced stablecoin plans, after the batch; no acquisition of SpotPay reported.

market_need_then: Cross border payments are costly and stablecoin adoption grew in 2025; the YC launch post says SpotPay was live in 40 plus countries shortly after launching.

branding.domain_note: Uses spotpay.ai, not .com; no purchase info found

identity.logo: Not described by any source opened
identity.voice_and_tone: Short product copy such as One powerful digital wallet; site has spelling errors

branding.brand_signature: The Calypso Card name for its card

brand_strength.rationale: Generic compound name that collides with an older Spot and Pay company, with sloppy site copy and no press about the brand.

outcome_analysis: SpotPay is a Winter 2026 company with two experienced fintech and Google founders and no public funding data, so no outcome exists yet. It competes in a crowded stablecoin neobank field where entrants like KAST had funded earlier, and the key risks are compliance, distribution and a generic brand.
notes: No funding found; Altss lists family office investors without amounts, not recorded. Site footer says it is a registered US Money Services Business with FinCEN and not a bank. YC page calls the card a credit card while the site and app listing say Calypso card, type unclear. Outcome search returned only unrelated Spot and Pay Inc. Founded 2025 per YC page.
